claims.caveat: Do not assign its shutdown to every operation.

claims.subject: concentrators
claims.statement: The three concentrators report output as copper in concentrate.
claims.caveat: Contained metal, gross concentrate, anode and sales are different measures.

claims.subject: concentrators
claims.statement: Management planned to prioritize on-site smelting of their concentrate.
claims.caveat: Not proof every tonne follows this route.

claims.subject: smelter
claims.caveat: The reporting date is later than the event date.

claims.subject: smelter
claims.caveat: Six acid offtakers are reported in April but not named there.

claims.statement: CITIC has an anode offtake agreement.
claims.caveat: Combined 80% with Gold Mountains; no equal split inferred; signed contracts not archived.

claims.subject: kamoa-copper
claims.statement: Gold Mountains has an anode offtake agreement.
claims.caveat: Combined 80% with CITIC; exact start/end dates not established.

claims.subject: kamoa-copper
claims.statement: A June 2025 agreement allocates the remaining 20% to Trafigura Asia for three years.
claims.caveat: Day and expiry not specified; group-level Trafigura is a separate entity record.

claims.caveat: Sale completion does not establish refinery arrival or named receiving plant.

claims.subject: anodes

claims.caveat: Refers to this transaction, not all Kamoa anodes.

claims.subject: dry-port
claims.statement: Rail movement toward Lobito was planned in the following days.
claims.caveat: Do not render it as completed on the publication date.

claims.subject: anodes
claims.statement: The first anode shipment arrived at Lobito during Q1 2026.
claims.caveat: Quarter resolution; no exact arrival day or cargo ID established.

claims.subject: aurubis
claims.caveat: Historical group capability; not a batch-level trace.

claims.subject: aurubis
claims.statement: Aurubis describes wire rod production from cathodes.
claims.caveat: Does not identify the plant processing the Kamoa cargo.

claims.subject: aurubis
claims.statement: A long-term rod supply agreement particularly serves Prysmian European plants.
claims.caveat: Exact quantities, expiry, named plants and continued fulfilment are not established.

claims.subject: prysmian
claims.statement: Prysmian describes energy and telecom cable systems operations.
claims.caveat: Not evidence that this Kamoa batch entered any particular cable.

claims.subject: rod
claims.statement: Wire rod is a precursor for copper wire and cable.
claims.caveat: Educational relation only; no customer or shipment identity.

events.description: Seismic activity, pumping damage and flooding interrupted portions of Kakula.
Western-side mining restarted; not a full-complex restart.
First anode expected in October. Preserve as a forecast.
Sale completed and cargo at Kolwezi dry port; onward rail/ocean steps still planned.
Arrival at Lobito reported; Europe arrival still expected in May.

excluded_assertions: Kamoa copper was physically incorporated into Prysmian cables.
The May 2025 disruption reduced Prysmian output by a known amount.
Aurubis received this cargo at Hamburg, Olen or Pirdop specifically.
All three Kamoa offtakers have equal shares.
The smelter operated in October 2025 because the June release predicted it.
The title 'refined copper' means the February shipment was cathode rather than anode.
A third-party independent investigation corroborated all participant statements.
